conf.description: Forescout eyeSight/CounterACT CEF Plugin customized-message feed (nac-event, syslog-cef): label-indirection CEF decode per recommendations.direct.cribl - no Elastic/Cribl-pack parser exists for Forescout CEF.

conf.comment: nac-event/syslog-cef: Send Customized CEF Message output. Splits the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header segments, then extracts the fixed dictionary extension keys (dst/dmac/dhost/dvc/dvchost/rt) by name. Per recommendations.direct.cribl, cs1..cs6/cs1Label..cs6Label are per-policy operator bindings with no stable slot meaning, so the whole raw extension string is retained as one custom audit field instead of guessing a per-slot mapping (README gap). dst is the endpoint, mapped to host.ip not destination.ip - this message describes no flow.

functions.description: why slot-level CEF fields are not individually resolved
Split the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header segments
Extract CEF extension key dst (endpoint IP)
Extract CEF extension key dmac (endpoint MAC)
Extract CEF extension key dhost (endpoint host name)
Extract CEF extension key dvc (CounterACT device IP)
Extract CEF extension key dvchost (CounterACT device host name)
Extract CEF extension key rt (event detection time, epoch ms)
batch every status:mapped/partial field that needed no further transform
